## Overview

This analysis performs label transfer from the AIBS Motor Cortex reference dataset to identify cell types in the Lawler PV dataset using Seurat's anchor-based integration method.

## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)
# library(plotly)
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
if (!file.exists("../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_query.rds")){
  # Load count matrices and metadata
  lawler <- Read10X('../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_10x_format/')
  meta_lawler <- read.csv('../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_10x_format/metadata.csv', row.names = 1)
  # Create Seurat objects
  query <- CreateSeuratObject(lawler, meta.data = meta_lawler, project = "Lawler_PV")
} else {
  query <- readRDS("../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_query.rds")
}

if (!file.exists("../data/nemo_archive_processed/reference_057.rds")){
  # Load count matrices and metadata
  aibs_strpal <- Read10X('../data/nemo_archive_processed/STR-PAL_10x_format/')
  meta_aibs_strpal <- read.csv('../data/nemo_archive_processed/STR-PAL_10x_format/metadata.csv', row.names = 1)
  # Create Seurat objects
  reference <- CreateSeuratObject(aibs_strpal, meta.data = meta_aibs_strpal, project = "AIBS_STR-PAL")
  reference$cluster_id <- sub(pattern = " .*", x = reference$cluster, replacement = "")
  
  rm(aibs_strpal)
  gc()
} else {
  reference <- readRDS("../data/nemo_archive_processed/reference_057.rds")
}

print(paste("Query dataset:", ncol(query), "cells,", nrow(query), "genes"))
print(paste("Reference dataset:", ncol(reference), "cells,", nrow(reference), "genes"))
```

## Process Query Dataset

```{r process-query}
# Pre-process query dataset
query <- NormalizeData(query, verbose = FALSE)
query <- FindVariableFeatures(query, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
query <- ScaleData(query, verbose = FALSE)
query <- RunPCA(query, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
query <- RunUMAP(query, dims = 1:30, return.model=TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
```
```{r process-query-viz, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# Visualize query dataset before label transfer
p3 <- DimPlot(query, reduction = "umap", group.by = "pv_status") +
  ggtitle("Lawler Query - PV Status")

p4 <- DimPlot(query, reduction = "umap", group.by = "brain_region") +
  ggtitle("Lawler Query - Brain Region")

p5 <- DimPlot(query, reduction = "umap", group.by = "treatment") +
  ggtitle("Lawler Query - Treatment")

p3 | p4 | p5
```

## Label Transfer Analysis

```{r find-anchors}
# Find transfer anchors
cat("Finding transfer anchors...\n")
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = reference, 
  query = query, 
  dims = 1:30,
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  verbose = FALSE
)

cat("Number of anchors found:", length(anchors@anchors), "\n")
```
```{r label-transfer-supertype}
# Transfer labels
cat("Transferring labels...\n")
predictions <- TransferData(
  anchorset = anchors, 
  refdata = reference$supertype,  # 3rd level taxonomy
  # refdata = reference$cluster,  # 4th level taxonomy
  k.weight = 28,
  dims = 1:30,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Save clean query object and prediction table
# saveRDS(query, "../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_query.rds")
write.csv(predictions, "../data/Lawler_2020/processed/label_transfer_preds_supertype_lawler2strpal057.csv")

# Add predictions to query object
query <- AddMetaData(query, metadata = predictions)

cat("Label transfer completed!\n")
```

```{r label-transfer-cluster}
# Transfer labels
cat("Transferring labels...\n")
predictions <- TransferData(
  anchorset = anchors, 
  # refdata = reference$supertype,  # 3rd level taxonomy
  refdata = reference$cluster,  # 4th level taxonomy
  k.weight = 28,
  dims = 1:30,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Save clean query object and prediction table
# saveRDS(query, "../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_query.rds")
write.csv(predictions, "../data/Lawler_2020/processed/label_transfer_preds_cluster_lawler2strpal057.csv")

# Add predictions to query object
query <- AddMetaData(query, metadata = predictions)

cat("Label transfer completed!\n")
```

## Visualization of Transfer Results

### Prediction Scores and Confidence

```{r prediction-quality, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
# Plot prediction scores
p6 <- FeaturePlot(query, features = "prediction.score.max", reduction = "umap") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  ggtitle("Maximum Prediction Score")

# Plot prediction confidence
prediction_scores <- query@meta.data[, grep("prediction.score", colnames(query@meta.data))]
query$prediction_confidence <- apply(prediction_scores, 1, max) - apply(prediction_scores, 1, function(x) sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)[2])

p7 <- FeaturePlot(query, features = "prediction_confidence", reduction = "umap") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  ggtitle("Prediction Confidence (Max - 2nd Max)")

p6 | p7
```

### Predicted Cell Types

```{r predicted-celltypes, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# Main prediction plot
p8 <- DimPlot(query, reduction = "umap", group.by = "predicted.id", label = TRUE, label.size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Predicted Cell Subclasses") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

# Prediction counts
prediction_counts <- table(query$predicted.id)
prediction_df <- data.frame(
  Subclass = names(prediction_counts),
  Count = as.numeric(prediction_counts)
)

p9 <- ggplot(prediction_df, aes(x = reorder(Subclass, Count), y = Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Predicted Cell Type Counts", x = "Cell Subclass", y = "Number of Cells")

p8 | p9
```

### Co-embedding Query on Reference UMAP

```{r map-query}
# Map query cells to reference UMAP space
query <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  reference = reference,
  query = query,
  refdata = list(celltype = "subclass"),
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  reduction.model = "umap",
  transferdata.args = list(k.weight = FALSE)
)
```

```{r co-embedding}
# Extract coordinates for plotting
ref_umap <- reference@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
# query_umap <- query@reductions$ref.umap@cell.embeddings
selected_samples <- c(
  "PVpos_gpe_Sham_rep1","PVpos_gpe_Sham_rep2"
  # "PVneg_gpe_Sham_rep1","PVneg_gpe_Sham_rep2"
  )
query_df <- query@meta.data |> 
  bind_cols(query@reductions$ref.umap@cell.embeddings)
query_df <- query_df[selected_samples,]

query_df$pv_status <- recode(
  query_df$pv_status, PVpos = "GPe PV+", PVneg = "GPe PV-"
)

# Create combined plotting dataframe
plot_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    UMAP1 = ref_umap[,1],
    UMAP2 = ref_umap[,2],
    dataset = "Reference",
    cell_type = reference$subclass,
    predicted_type = reference$subclass,
    pv_status = NA,
    brain_region = NA,
    treatment = NA,
    prediction_score = 1.0
  ),
  data.frame(
    UMAP1 = query_df$refUMAP_1,
    UMAP2 = query_df$refUMAP_2,
    dataset = "Query",
    cell_type = query_df$predicted.id,
    predicted_type = query_df$predicted.id,
    pv_status = query_df$pv_status,
    brain_region = query_df$brain_region,
    treatment = query_df$treatment,
    prediction_score = query_df$prediction.score.max
  )
)

plot_data$pv_status <- factor(
  plot_data$pv_status, levels = c("GPe PV+", "GPe PV-")
)

# Create a summary dataframe for label positions (one label per predicted cell type)
query_labels <- plot_data %>%
  filter(dataset == "Query") %>%
  group_by(predicted_type) %>%
  summarise(
    UMAP1 = median(UMAP1),
    UMAP2 = median(UMAP2),
    label = paste0('Predicted: ', unique(predicted_type)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
```

```{r co-embed-with-labels, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5.3}
pal <- brewer.pal(n=12,name="Paired")

# Main plot with repelled labels
p_coembed_labeled <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_data, dataset == "Reference"), 
             color = "lightgray", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_data, dataset == "Query"), 
             aes(fill = pv_status, color = 'black'), shape = 24, size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data = query_labels,
                  aes(label = label),
                  size = 3,
                  fontface = "bold",
                  color = "black",
                  bg.color = "white",
                  bg.r = 0.1,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.5,
                  min.segment.length = 0.2,
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  force = 2,
                  seed = 42) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GPe PV+" = pal[3], "GPe PV-" = pal[5])) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black")) +
  theme_void() +
  # theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Query Data Mapped to Reference UMAP Space",
       subtitle = "Gray: Reference cells    Circles: Query data",
       fill = "Identity") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
print(p_coembed_labeled)
```

### Anchor Quality Assessment

```{r anchor-assessment}
# Visualize anchor connections
anchor_df <- data.frame(
  reference_cell = anchors@anchors[,1],
  query_cell = anchors@anchors[,2],
  score = anchors@anchors[,3]
)

p15 <- ggplot(anchor_df, aes(x = score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Anchor Scores", 
       x = "Anchor Score", y = "Count")

print(p15)

cat("Anchor Statistics:\n")
cat("Total anchors:", nrow(anchor_df), "\n")
cat("Mean anchor score:", round(mean(anchor_df$score), 3), "\n")
cat("Median anchor score:", round(median(anchor_df$score), 3), "\n")
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r summary-stats}
# Create summary table
summary_table <- query@meta.data %>%
  group_by(predicted.id, pv_status, brain_region, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    mean_pred_score = mean(prediction.score.max),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cells))

print(summary_table)

# Overall summary
cat("\nOverall Summary:\n")
cat("Total query cells:", ncol(query), "\n")
cat("Unique predicted cell types:", length(unique(query$predicted.id)), "\n")
cat("Mean prediction score:", round(mean(query$prediction.score.max), 3), "\n")
cat("Cells with high confidence (>0.5):", sum(query$prediction.score.max > 0.5), "\n")
cat("Percentage high confidence:", round(100 * sum(query$prediction.score.max > 0.5) / ncol(query), 1), "%\n")
```

```{r save-umap-coords}
query_df <- query@meta.data |> 
  bind_cols(query@reductions$ref.umap@cell.embeddings)
query_df <- query_df |>
  filter(brain_region %in% c("gpe")) |>
  filter(pv_status == "PVpos") |>
  mutate(region_pv = paste(brain_region, pv_status, sep = "_"))

query_df$region_pv <- recode(
  query_df$region_pv, 
  gpe_PVpos = "GPe PV+", gpe_PVneg = "GPe PV-"
)

# Create combined plotting dataframe
plot_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    UMAP1 = ref_umap[,1],
    UMAP2 = ref_umap[,2],
    dataset = "Reference",
    cluster = reference$cluster,
    predicted_type = NA,
    brain_region = NA,
    pv_status = NA,
    region_pv = NA,
    treatment = NA,
    prediction_score = NA
  ),
  data.frame(
    UMAP1 = query_df$refUMAP_1,
    UMAP2 = query_df$refUMAP_2,
    dataset = "Query",
    cluster = query_df$predicted.id,
    predicted_type = query_df$predicted.id,
    brain_region = query_df$brain_region,
    pv_status = query_df$pv_status,
    region_pv = query_df$region_pv,
    treatment = query_df$treatment,
    prediction_score = query_df$prediction.score.max
  )
)

write.csv(plot_data, "../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler2strpal057_plot_data.csv")
```
